title: Bid Your Lucky Days To Win A Real Floating Island
description: Four strangers bid their own lucky days for a real floating island, and the island has its own rule. How many lucky days would you bid? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Madame Ume: 80-year-old Japanese woman auctioneer, long silver hair in a loose braid, deep-set kind eyes, long dark green hooded robe with brass buttons, holding a small brass hand bell, no glasses, hood down
characters.Sachi: 10-year-old Japanese girl, short black bob with a yellow hair clip, round cheeks, red raincoat over a white t-shirt, navy shorts, yellow rubber boots, no hat
characters.Taro: 40-year-old Japanese fisherman, short black hair with grey at the temples, stubble, faded blue work jacket over a white undershirt, khaki trousers, black rubber boots, holding a large black umbrella, no hat
characters.Lena: 30-year-old German woman, long wavy blonde hair, sharp blue eyes, beige trench coat, grey turtleneck, black trousers, brown ankle boots, no hat, no glasses
characters.Benji: 35-year-old American man, curly brown hair, thin round glasses, nervous face, brown corduroy blazer over a mustard sweater vest and white shirt, dark brown trousers, brown loafers, no hat

scenes.say: Four strangers, one auction, one real floating island. The catch? You don't pay with money. You pay with lucky days, and they leave your life the second you bid.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Wide shot of a quiet grassy cliff top by the sea at dusk, a single green floating island with one small tree hovering high above the water, Sachi, Taro, Lena and Benji standing small on the grass looking up. [4-7s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top of Benji and Lena side by side, staring up with open mouths, sea wind in their hair. [7-10s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Sachi's face, eyes shining as she looks up at the floating island.

scenes.say: Madame Ume rings her bell. Rule one: everyone owns exactly one thousand lucky days. Bid more, and the wind takes you home. Rule two: the island only floats for a light heart.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top at dusk of Madame Ume ringing her small brass hand bell, robe moving in the wind. [4-7s] Close-up of Madame Ume on the cliff top raising one finger, a soft warm glow around the bell. [7-10s] Low angle on the grassy cliff top looking past Madame Ume's shoulder up at the floating island drifting slowly in the orange sky.

scenes.say: Ten-year-old Sachi bids first: one day. Everyone laughs. Taro bids two hundred, Lena five hundred, Benji eight hundred. So Taro panics, shouts twelve hundred, and a gust sweeps him away.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top of Sachi raising her hand high while Lena and Benji laugh beside her. [4-7s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Taro gripping his black umbrella, sweating, shouting a bid. [7-10s] Medium shot above the grassy cliff top: Taro's black umbrella pops open and a gentle gust lifts him slowly into the dusk sky toward the town, his face surprised and calm.

scenes.say: Now it's Lena against Benji. Lena bids nine fifty. Benji, nine ninety. Lena, nine ninety-five. Benji goes all in at nine ninety-nine, keeping one lucky day. Lena bows out. Sold.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Lena's face, eyes narrowed, raising her hand. [4-7s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Benji pushing up his round glasses, trembling, raising his hand. [7-10s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top of Madame Ume ringing her brass bell once while Lena lowers her hand and steps back with a small bow.

scenes.say: But with one lucky day left, Benji can't stop worrying. And the island starts sinking. It drifts away from him, over the grass, and floats down low beside Sachi.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Benji biting his nails, sweat on his forehead, staring up. [4-7s] Wide shot of the grassy cliff top at dusk as the floating island tilts and slowly sinks, gliding away from Benji. [7-10s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top of the floating island hovering low just beside Sachi, its small tree swaying, Sachi looking up in wonder.

scenes.say: Rule two: it only floats for a light heart. Sachi still has nine hundred ninety-nine lucky days. Benji has one. Four strangers, one island, and it picked the girl who bid one.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Medium shot on the grassy cliff top of Madame Ume smiling and holding up two fingers. [4-7s] Close-up on the grassy cliff top of Sachi grinning and reaching a hand out to Benji. [7-10s] Wide shot of the floating island rising into the dusk sky over the sea with Sachi and Benji sitting together under its small tree, Benji finally laughing.
